finalResult.previousParagraphText: Jake couldn’t truly say he related, but he could empathize with what his brother had to have felt like when away in Nevermore. Even now, it couldn’t be easy. Going off-world for a few months was a short trip by the standards of the multiverse, yet it was long enough to make him miss so many new things. It only had to have been worse when Adam was even younger.
